internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across most of its forms qrr denotes settledness: a thing coming to rest and staying fixed in a place or condition. The finite verbs anchor it literally — the mountain that would 'stay put in its place' (istaqarra, 7:143), the command to 'remain settled in your houses' (qarna, 33:33), and God 'causing to lodge/settle in the wombs what He wills' (nuqirru, 22:5). From this the nouns follow: the earth 'made a stable footing' (qaraaran, 27:61/40:64), the womb as a 'firm lodging' (qaraarin makiin, 23:13/77:21), earthly and eschatological 'abodes' (mustaqarr; daar al-qaraar). Fixity in place shades internally into a fixed appointed point (the sun running 'to a settling-point for it', 36:38; 'for every tiding a settled point', 6:67; the final 'settled destination to your Lord', 75:12). The negative case is diagnostic: the uprooted evil tree 'has no qaraar' (14:26) = no fixed footing. But the root is not one meaning: 'affirm/acknowledge a covenant' (aqrartum, 2:84; 3:81) is a bleached speech-act, the qurrat-ʿayn 'eye-comfort' idiom is locked to ʿayn and paired with 'not grieving', and qawaariir 'glass/crystal' carries no fixity content at all.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: POSITIVE: settled/stationary/enduring fixity of a thing at a place or point; a locus of rest (abode/lodging); an appointed fixed terminus; causing-to-settle. NEGATIVE (what qrr does NOT entail): not temporary deposit/entrustment (mustawdaʿ, contrasted at 11:6, 6:98); not transient enjoyment (mataaʿ, contrasted at 2:36, 7:24, 40:39); not standing/station (muqaam, 25:66/76) nor brief repose (maqiil, 25:24); not permanence-as-such (earthly mustaqarr is time-bounded 'ilaa hiin', 2:36/7:24); no inherent positive valence (Hell: saa'at mustaqarran 25:66; ʿadhaab mustaqirr 54:38); does NOT itself mean coolness/joy (the eye-idiom's internal frame is grief↔contentment, 20:40/28:13/33:51, never temperature); does NOT encode speech/cognition (the 'affirm' content is absent from every fixity token); and the triliteral shell does NOT guarantee any rest-semantics (qawaariir 'glass').

This concrete nominal shares only the consonantal skeleton and decisively defeats any UNIVERSAL/single-nucleus whole-root claim (same root != one meaning).
